rules.rule: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus without complications should be coded as E11.9. Do not confuse with Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus (E10.9) unless explicitly documented as insulin-dependent type 1 or juvenile-onset.
Essential (primary) hypertension without secondary causes or complications is coded as I10.

Asthma without chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) should be coded under J45 series (e.g., J45.909). COPD without asthma should be coded as J44.9. If asthma is assigned a J44 code, it is an inconsistency.
Unspecified bacterial or infectious pneumonia without documented viral/organism specificity is coded as J18.9.
The proposed ICD code must exist in the project's ICD lookup table. Empty, missing, or unmapped codes are invalid.
